section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction section reviews the development and validation of body appreciation measures, specifically the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version, the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The text discusses how the BAS was initially developed as a 13-item unidimensional measure but showed variable factor structures across different cultural groups, leading to the development of the 10-item BAS-2. The section documents the psychometric validation of both instruments across numerous countries and populations, including college and community samples from the U.S., Europe, Asia, and other regions, establishing that BAS-2 scores demonstrate one-dimensional factor structure with good psychometric properties across cultural groups.
